title: Viva Insights: export de-identified agent metrics from the Agent Dashboard
summary: The briefing passes: the rollout, default, access restrictions and policy controls are supported, and the changed PowerShell guide does not invalidate its commands or policy limits. Minor corrections should clarify the licensing classification, qualify the preview's data windows and acknowledge the identification navigation differences.
